name: muller-brockmann-grid-systems
description: Build editorial/magazine/report webpages on a GENUINE Müller-Brockmann modular grid (International Typographic Style), not a decorative one — columns + modules + baseline, grotesque type, flush-left ragged-right, restrained black/white/red — with the engineering that makes the grid load-bearing: CSS-variable source of truth, in-box grid-toggle overlay, subgrid bands, 8px baseline lock, optical alignment, a scaffold generator, and a Puppeteer harness proving 0px adherence. Triggers: magazine spread, grid system, Swiss design, editorial layout, grid overlay, baseline/modular grid, 12-column layout, 瑞士网格, 版面网格.
